speaker: consultant
text: Good morning, this is Elena Ward.

speaker: customer
text: Good morning. My name is Hannah Brooks. I own a small bookshop and I am looking at a few consultants.

speaker: consultant
text: Thank you for calling, Hannah. How can I help?

speaker: customer
text: I would like to understand the difference between your Growth Package and the Monthly Retainer.

speaker: consultant
text: The Growth Package is six sessions over three months, for nine hundred and fifty dollars. It is a fixed project.

speaker: consultant
text: The retainer is six hundred dollars per month, with two sessions each month and email support. The minimum is three months.

speaker: customer
text: So the retainer is more expensive in total.

speaker: consultant
text: Yes, it is for clients who want ongoing support rather than a single project.

speaker: customer
text: I see. How long does it take before we actually start working?

speaker: consultant
text: After signing, you get an intake questionnaire within twenty-four hours, and the kickoff session is within ten days.

speaker: customer
text: Okay. I am also talking to two other consultants this week.

speaker: consultant
text: That is very sensible. Would you like me to email you an overview of both options?

speaker: customer
text: Yes, please. I want to compare everything side by side before I decide.

speaker: consultant
text: I will send it this afternoon. Should I check in with you next week?

speaker: consultant
text: Great. I will call you on Friday, Hannah.
